name: fonts-arcade
title: Gamestage fonts, arcade
description: Unbounded for the numbers and actions a player tracks, DM Sans for interface text, linked from Google Fonts. The arcade theme names Unbounded as its display family; this item is what puts it on the page. Installed for you by @gamestage/theme-arcade.

files.content:
/* Gamestage fonts, arcade theme.

   The same two faces the base theme loads, because arcade uses the same two.
   It named Bungee as its display face until GSUI-171, which is a face the
   design never names.

   A theme may name any family it likes, because type.fontFamily.interface and
   .display are tokens; what it cannot do is load one. Without this stylesheet
   the family is simply absent and the theme looks as though it changed nothing.

   Import once at the root, before gamestage-tokens.css. Hosts that control
   their own <head> should also add
     <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
   which a stylesheet cannot express. */
@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400..900&family=Unbounded:wght@500..900&display=swap");

docs: Import gamestage-fonts-arcade.css once at the root, before gamestage-tokens.css, in place of gamestage-fonts.css. The `font` block is metadata the installer reads for nothing; the Google Fonts `@import` in the stylesheet loads the family, and `font.import` is blank because BDS-005 chose to link Google Fonts rather than self-host. A theme can name any family it likes, because the families are tokens; what it cannot do is load one, and a theme whose family is not loaded falls through its stack in silence and looks like a theme that changed nothing.
